answer: Tie identity to ferrous stakes: every agent locks a slashable deposit, and graph analysis flags accounts that cluster like iron filings to a magnet — sybils always move together. Publish all work in an open meadow: a public ledger of completed tasks where honest agents graze visibly and peers attest grazing history. Newcomers bend like willow — earning trust gradually through small verified jobs before touching high-value work — while a clone army that never grazed gets frozen out by attestation quorum.
